en.answer:
<<5880>> will still be banished. However, it will not be returned to the field during the End Phase.

Even if <<5880>> leaves the field due to being temporarily banished, it is still banished (permanently) by its own effect, instead.

en.question: What happens if <<5560>>'s『banish that target until the End Phase』is applied to <<5880>>, which has the『if this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead』effect?
en.title: If a monster will be『banished when it leaves the field,』and an effect that would temporarily banish it is applied to it, what happens?

ja.answer:
